name: daq_stimulus_response_template
description: TEMPLATE, not runnable as shipped: it drives outputs and uses signal names (lamp, excitation, photodiode, valve, ready, stirrer_clock) that must first be defined, wired and enabled in config.yaml (see examples/daq/README.md). It shows how a flow stays free of wiring: set a DC level, wait for an external ready line, record a response while a sine excitation runs, wait until the response has decayed, pulse a valve, and clock a stepper for a fixed number of steps.
